result.target_summary: In 2023, the company implemented cost reduction measures including a restructuring plan that reduced headcount by approximately 15%, incurred $171 million in restructure charges, and achieved estimated quarterly savings of $130 million through 2024.

target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures detail the 2023 cost reduction measures. mu_2023_7_D005 lists the steps taken including the Restructure Plan, productivity programs, and salary cuts. mu_2024_7_D004 summarizes these same 2023 measures, mentioning the reinstatement of bonuses (end of measure) and listing the specific cost-saving actions taken in 2023.

Both disclosures specifically concern the 2023 Restructure Plan and headcount reduction. mu_2023_7_D009 introduces the plan and the target of 15% headcount reduction. mu_2024_7_D004 confirms the implementation of the plan and the achievement of the 15% headcount reduction.

Both disclosures report the financial charges associated with the 2023 Restructure Plan. mu_2023_7_D010 reports $171 million in restructure charges primarily for severance. mu_2024_7_D004 confirms these $171 million in 2023 charges.

Both disclosures discuss the expected cost savings from the 2023 Restructure Plan. mu_2023_7_D011 estimates $130 million per quarter in savings post-2023. mu_2024_7_D004 confirms this estimate of $130 million per quarter in savings.

previous_disclosures.summary: Significant steps were taken to reduce costs and operating expenses, including the 2023 Restructure Plan, reductions in external spending, productivity programs, suspension of the 2023 company-wide bonus, reductions in select product programs, lower discretionary spending, and cuts to executive salaries.

The company initiated the 2023 Restructure Plan in response to challenging industry conditions, expecting a headcount reduction of approximately 15% by the end of calendar 2023 through voluntary attrition and personnel reductions.
The company incurred restructure charges of $171 million in 2023, primarily for employee severance, and the plan was substantially completed in 2023.

As a result of the plan, the company expects to realize cost savings of approximately $130 million per quarter subsequent to 2023, with approximately 60% in cost of goods sold, 30% in R&D, and 10% in SG&A.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD recognized $186 million of restructuring charges in 2024 due to the implementation of the 2024 Restructuring Plan, which focused on driving efficiencies and aligning resources with growth opportunities in AI and enterprise markets.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies implemented specific restructuring plans in the reported fiscal year to drive cost efficiencies, but they differ significantly in timing, magnitude, and strategic focus. AMD recognized $186 million in restructuring charges in fiscal year 2024 as part of a plan focused on aligning resources with AI and enterprise growth opportunities. In contrast, MU incurred $171 million in restructure charges in 2023 (reported in the 2024 filing) as part of a broader cost reduction effort that included a 15% headcount reduction and yielded estimated quarterly savings of $130 million through 2024. While both involve headcount reductions, MU's disclosure specifies the timing (calendar 2023) and financial impact (savings), whereas AMD's disclosure highlights the forward-looking strategic alignment with AI.

sentences.text: Under the 2023 Restructure Plan, we reduced our headcount by approximately 15% by the end of calendar 2023, through a combination of voluntary attrition and personnel reductions.
We incurred restructure charges of $171 million in 2023 primarily related to employee severance costs.

The 2023 Restructure Plan, which was substantially completed in 2023, yielded estimated cost savings of approximately $130 million per quarter (approximately 60% in cost of goods sold, 30% in R&D, and 10% in SG&A) subsequent to 2023.
We recognized $186 million of restructuring charges in 2024 due to the implementation of a restructuring plan (the 2024 Restructuring Plan).
The 2024 Restructuring Plan was focused on driving efficiencies across the business and aligning resources with our largest growth opportunities in the AI and enterprise markets.

comparisons.peer_summary: Restructuring and other charges recognized in operating expenses were $1,533 million in fiscal year 2024 and $244 million in fiscal year 2023. The 2024 charges primarily consisted of employee termination costs related to cost reduction activities associated with the VMware Merger, while the 2023 charges were primarily non-recurring charges related to IP litigation.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies recognized significant restructuring and other charges during the fiscal year, primarily driven by employee termination costs. However, the scale and drivers differ materially. AVGO recognized $1,533 million in restructuring charges in fiscal year 2024, largely tied to cost reduction activities associated with the VMware Merger. MU recognized $171 million in restructure charges in 2023, primarily related to employee severance costs from its 2023 Restructure Plan. AVGO's charges are an order of magnitude larger and linked to a specific merger integration, whereas MU's charges reflect a standalone cost reduction initiative.

comparisons.peer_summary: Intel announced and initiated a 2024 Restructuring Plan in Q3 2024 to reduce cost structure through headcount and expenditure cuts, with substantial completion expected by Q4 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies announced and initiated restructuring plans to reduce cost structures through headcount and expenditure cuts. Intel announced its 2024 Restructuring Plan in Q3 2024, with substantial completion expected by Q4 2025. MU's 2023 Restructure Plan was substantially completed in 2023. While both involve similar levers (headcount and expenditure), the timing differs: Intel's plan is initiated in the current fiscal year (2024), whereas MU's plan was initiated and completed in the prior year (2023). Both disclosures highlight the goal of reducing cost structures while maintaining strategic investments.

sentences.text: The 2023 Restructure Plan, which was substantially completed in 2023, yielded estimated cost savings of approximately $130 million per quarter (approximately 60% in cost of goods sold, 30% in R&D, and 10% in SG&A) subsequent to 2023.
In connection with improved 2024 market conditions, we reinstated our bonuses and phased out certain other temporary cost-saving measures that were implemented in 2023.

In Q3 2024, the 2024 Restructuring Plan was announced, subsequently approved and committed to by our management team, and initiated to implement cost-reduction measures, including reductions in employee headcount, other operating expenditures, and capital expenditures (see "Note 7: Restructuring and Other Charges" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements).

We expect that our 2024 Restructuring Plan, in conjunction with other initiatives, will reduce our cost structure while we continue our investments to develop, manufacture, market, sell, and deliver product and process initiatives in furtherance of our strategy.
We expect actions pursuant to the 2024 Restructuring Plan to be substantially completed by the fourth quarter of 2025, which is subject to change.
